tracks.title: The Blade That Calls
tracks.prompt: Original epic fantasy RPG title-screen instrumental, titled The Blade That Calls. 150 seconds. The visual is a magnificent ancient golden sword suspended vertically above a glowing circular magical seal, gold embers and delicate arcane rings, with vast blue-black gothic fortress silhouettes behind it. Translate that image into music: mysterious dark spacious low strings and distant resonant bells, a luminous noble memorable brass and soaring string main melody representing the golden sword, crystalline celesta and harp glints for the gold magic, controlled deep orchestral drums and warm French horns for adventure. A powerful clear identity within the first 5 seconds; no long empty intro. Grand and emotionally uplifting, wonder and resolve shining against danger, not horror. Around 88 BPM, cinematic orchestral depth, human expressive phrasing, strong thematic composition rather than repetitive trailer hits. Broad unhurried melody, subtle shifting harmonies, a quieter enchanted middle passage, then a glorious layered return with countermelody. Suitable for sitting on a game menu: dynamic and majestic but not exhausting, no constant combat percussion, no aggressive high frequency noise. End on a soft suspended musical turnaround compatible with returning to the opening, no abrupt cut or explosive final sting. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir syllables, no speech, no lyrics, no sound effects.
